In this phase, players play upgrade cards, invade provinces with their figures and try to pillage Midgard. The phase ends, when either all provinces have been pillaged or no player has any Rage remaining.
During the Discard Phase, all players have to discard their remaining cards, but every player can keep one card from their hand for the next Age.

In this phase, all players draft the Gods' Gift to use during the current age. Every player is dealt eight cards and selects one to keep. The remaining cards are passed on to the next player on the left. All players select another card, and so on, until all players have drafted six cards.
In the Quest Phase, all quest cards played are revealed and Glory points and stat increases awarded if fulfilled. Quest cards are then discarded.

During the Ragnarök Phase, the doomed province is destroyed, all figures in it (and adjacent fjords) are destroyed and sent to Valhalla, and players are awarded points for each destroyed figure (according to the current Age).
